KXNCAAMBTOPAPRANK.quote: ranked top 10 on the Men's College Basketball AP Poll Final Rankings
KXNCAAMBTOPAPRANK.reason: Yes iff the team is in the top 10 of the AP Final Rankings; voter-driven final poll, same mechanism as KXNCAAMBAPRANK with a bucket threshold.

KXNCAAMBAWARD.reason: Yes iff the named player wins the stated award (here Final Four MOP); selection by voters/committee with 1/N co-recipient payout. Existing archetype covers Naismith and player awards; proposed player_awards merged here.

KXNCAAMBCONFAWARD.quote: wins the ACC Defensive Player of the Year award
KXNCAAMBCONFAWARD.reason: Yes iff the named player wins the conference award (e.g. ACC DPOY); voted selection with 1/N co-recipient payout and No if player does not play. Same mechanism as national awards, kept in polls_and_awards.

KXNCAAMBTEAMSQUAL.reason: Yes iff every listed team makes the 2027 NCAA tournament field (selection plus automatic bids); a joint make-the-field outcome, so refiled from futures_conference to seed/field futures.
